directive.quote: Build the Workshop tool "share anything", porting the logic one to one from the extracted owner where it is correct.

job: share anything of mine read-only with a person, an AI or anyone holding a link, from one record or one piece of text to a whole list or any mix of records, show who has access to it and stop it

its share-a-kept-show-type tool shares one show-rule preset by the older record shape (one label); this one shares any records by a reach, and writes the share itself instead of handing back records to keep
the sealed-link tool it held is deleted in this change; the folder keeps the sealing library the device copy worker imports
